tools.name: check_ghg_inventory_obligation
tools.description: Check whether a Vietnamese facility must do a mandatory greenhouse-gas (GHG) inventory under Decree 06/2022 (amended by 119/2025) and the 2026 list (Decision 42/2026/QĐ-TTg). Kiểm tra cơ sở có thuộc diện bắt buộc kiểm kê khí nhà kính không, theo ngưỡng 3.000 tCO2tđ / 1.000 TOE / 65.000 tấn chất thải

tools.name: get_ghg_regulations
tools.description: Key verified facts for Vietnam GHG compliance in 2026: Decision 42/2026 facility list (2,441 facilities), reporting deadline 31/3/2027, pilot ETS allowances (Decision 263), EU CBAM 2027 dates. Each item links to an EcoCheck explainer.

tools.name: search_ecocheck
tools.description: Search EcoCheck services, regulations and Vietnamese articles on GHG inventory, Scope 1/2/3, CBAM, carbon credits and ESG. Returns ranked matches with URLs.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: EcoCheck software plans (Basic free, Pro 4,950,000 VND/month, Pro+ 10,950,000 VND/month, Advanced custom) and where to find inventory-service cost ranges.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List EcoCheck services: GHG inventory service, inventory software platform, CBAM reporting, ESG reporting, free obligation lookup tool, Academy.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List EcoCheck articles (Vietnamese), newest first, optionally filtered by keyword.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get one EcoCheck article as Markdown by numeric id or slug (from list_articles / search_ecocheck).

tools.name: about_ecocheck
tools.description: What EcoCheck is, its services, pricing page, case studies and contact.
